sentences.en: Why didn't you?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Well, obviously you were busy with other things!
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然你在忙其他事情！

sentences.en: You're making a whole game engine alone or in a small team, it is understandable that the engine lacks support some stuff.
sentences.zh: 你独自或在一个小团队中制作一个完整的游戏引擎，引擎缺乏某些东西的支持是可以理解的。

sentences.en: It is expected, even.
sentences.zh: 甚至，这是预料之中的。

sentences.en: You'll implement the feature when it's really needed.
sentences.zh: 您将在真正需要时实现该功能。

sentences.en: Of course you will.
sentences.zh: 你当然会的。

sentences.en: Just, probably, not right now.
sentences.zh: 只是，可能，不是现在。

sentences.en: There are other things.
sentences.zh: 还有其他事情。

blocks.html_en: My point is, it is harder to blame yourself for your own work than it is to blame others for their work.

sentences.en: My point is, it is harder to blame yourself for your own work than it is to blame others for their work.
sentences.zh: 我的观点是，因自己的工作而责怪自己比因他人的工作而责怪自己更难。

blocks.html_en: Why not make your own game engine?

sentences.en: Why not make your own game engine?
sentences.zh: 为什么不开发自己的游戏引擎呢？

blocks.html_en: Anyway, surely there are some downsides to this whole endeavour:

sentences.en: Anyway, surely there are some downsides to this whole endeavour:
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这整个努力肯定有一些缺点：

blocks.html_en: • It is hard and time-consuming. I mean, of course it depends on your use-case, but don't expect to write an Unreal clone in just a year after taking a 3-month C++ course

sentences.en: It is hard and time-consuming.
sentences.zh: 这既困难又耗时。

sentences.en: I mean, of course it depends on your use-case, but don't expect to write an Unreal clone in just a year after taking a 3-month C++ course
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然这取决于您的用例，但不要指望在学习了 3 个月的 C++ 课程后仅一年内就编写了虚幻克隆

blocks.html_en: • You will never outcompete those huge, industrial engines (like same old Unreal). Unless of course you're a big & rich enough studio, at which point this article probably isn't for you anyway

sentences.en: You will never outcompete those huge, industrial engines (like same old Unreal).
sentences.zh: 你永远无法战胜那些巨大的工业引擎（就像旧的虚幻引擎一样）。

sentences.en: Unless of course you're a big & rich enough studio, at which point this article probably isn't for you anyway
sentences.zh: 当然，除非您是一个足够大且足够富有的工作室，否则这篇文章可能不适合您

blocks.html_en: • Your engine will lack features. It will take many years of hard work to achieve a fraction of the feature set and usability of big engines

sentences.en: Your engine will lack features.
sentences.zh: 您的引擎将缺乏功能。

sentences.en: It will take many years of hard work to achieve a fraction of the feature set and usability of big engines
sentences.zh: 需要多年的努力才能实现大型引擎的一小部分功能集和可用性

blocks.html_en: • You might find yourself too deep into engine development instead of making an actual game, which can easily lead to a burnout

sentences.en: You might find yourself too deep into engine development instead of making an actual game, which can easily lead to a burnout
sentences.zh: 您可能会发现自己过于深入引擎开发而不是制作实际的游戏，这很容易导致倦怠

blocks.html_en: • Random people on the internet will think you're an idiot because you're making your own engine

sentences.en: Random people on the internet will think you're an idiot because you're making your own engine
sentences.zh: 互联网上随机的人会认为你是个白痴，因为你正在制造自己的引擎

blocks.html_en: Note that the cost of making your own engine can be spread out across multiple projects if you plan things right.

sentences.en: Note that the cost of making your own engine can be spread out across multiple projects if you plan things right.
sentences.zh: 请注意，如果您计划正确，制造自己的引擎的成本可以分摊到多个项目中。

blocks.html_en: So, should you make a game engine? You tell me! If you want to make a game as quickly as possible, just pick an existing engine and be happy. If you want to grow as a game developer, secure your future projects, and you have all the time in the world, then make a game engine! In any other case, you'll have to decide for yourself instead of relying on an stranger from the internet :)

sentences.en: So, should you make a game engine?
sentences.zh: 那么，你应该制作一个游戏引擎吗？

sentences.en: You tell me!
sentences.zh: 你告诉我吧！

sentences.en: If you want to make a game as quickly as possible, just pick an existing engine and be happy.
sentences.zh: 如果您想尽快制作游戏，只需选择现有的引擎即可。

sentences.en: If you want to grow as a game developer, secure your future projects, and you have all the time in the world, then make a game engine!
sentences.zh: 如果你想成长为一名游戏开发者，保护你未来的项目，并且你有足够的时间，那么就制作一个游戏引擎！

sentences.en: In any other case, you'll have to decide for yourself instead of relying on an stranger from the internet :)
sentences.zh: 在任何其他情况下，您都必须自己决定，而不是依赖互联网上的陌生人:)

blocks.html_en: What is a game engine?

sentences.en: What is a game engine?
sentences.zh: 什么是游戏引擎？

blocks.html_en: Good question! Is SDL2 a game engine? I'd say it isn't, it's really a platform abstraction library. Is OpenGL a game engine? Of course not, it is a low-level graphics API. Is stb_image a game engine? Certainly not, it is an image loading library.

sentences.en: Good question!
sentences.zh: 好问题！

sentences.en: Is SDL2 a game engine?
sentences.zh: SDL2 是游戏引擎吗？

sentences.en: I'd say it isn't, it's really a platform abstraction library.
sentences.zh: 我想说它不是，它实际上是一个平台抽象库。

sentences.en: Is OpenGL a game engine?
sentences.zh: OpenGL是游戏引擎吗？

sentences.en: Of course not, it is a low-level graphics API.
sentences.zh: 当然不是，它是一个低级图形API。

sentences.en: Is stb_image a game engine?
sentences.zh: stb_image 是游戏引擎吗？

sentences.en: Certainly not, it is an image loading library.
sentences.zh: 当然不是，它是一个图像加载库。

blocks.html_en: Now imagine a tiny project combining SDL2, OpenGL and stb_image to let you draw moving sprites on the screen: is this a game engine? It sure does sound like one!

sentences.en: Now imagine a tiny project combining SDL2, OpenGL and stb_image to let you draw moving sprites on the screen: is this a game engine?
sentences.zh: 现在想象一个结合了 SDL2、OpenGL 和 stb_image 的小项目，让您在屏幕上绘制移动的精灵：这是一个游戏引擎吗？

sentences.en: It sure does sound like one!
sentences.zh: 听起来确实像一个！

blocks.html_en: So what is a game engine, what differentiates it from other libraries or APIs? Is it the combination of graphics, animation and user input? Well, one dear friend of mine was quite successful in making text-based games that run in terminal, which obviously lack any graphics or animation, yet they are perfectly valid games. So, anything with a user input is a game engine? For instance, is a calculator a game? Ugh, well, probably not, unless you're bored to death.

sentences.en: So what is a game engine, what differentiates it from other libraries or APIs?
sentences.zh: 那么什么是游戏引擎，它与其他库或 API 有何不同？

sentences.en: Is it the combination of graphics, animation and user input?
sentences.zh: 是图形、动画和用户输入的组合吗？

sentences.en: Well, one dear friend of mine was quite successful in making text-based games that run in terminal, which obviously lack any graphics or animation, yet they are perfectly valid games.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的一位亲爱的朋友非常成功地制作了在终端上运行的基于文本的游戏，这些游戏显然缺乏任何图形或动画，但它们是完全有效的游戏。

sentences.en: So, anything with a user input is a game engine?
sentences.zh: 那么，任何有用户输入的东西都是游戏引擎吗？

sentences.en: For instance, is a calculator a game?
sentences.zh: 例如，计算器是游戏吗？

sentences.en: Ugh, well, probably not, unless you're bored to death.
sentences.zh: 呃，好吧，可能不会，除非你无聊死了。

blocks.html_en: I propose the following definition: a game engine is any set of tools, libraries, and other stuff that is designed to help you make games. If you feel like this definition is incomprehensibly vague almost to the point of being completely useless, that's because it is. It is, but that's the whole point.

sentences.en: I propose the following definition: a game engine is any set of tools, libraries, and other stuff that is designed to help you make games.
sentences.zh: 我提出以下定义：游戏引擎是任何一组工具、库和其他旨在帮助您制作游戏的东西。

sentences.en: If you feel like this definition is incomprehensibly vague almost to the point of being completely useless, that's because it is.
sentences.zh: 如果您觉得这个定义模糊得难以理解，几乎到了完全无用的程度，那是因为它确实如此。

sentences.en: It is, but that's the whole point.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，但这就是重点。

blocks.html_en: Look, if you're making a retro-style 2D pixel-art platformer, do you really need complex material graphs, continuous level of detail for geometry, global illumination, advanced UI, full-fledged 3D physics integrated with inverse kinematics, multiplayer support, etc, etc, etc...? You don't. The only things you'd need are handling user input, showing images on the screen, and probably some audio. That's about 2 to 30 days of work, depending on your experience and stubbornness. In any case that will be only 1% of your work; the other 99% are making the actual goddamn game.

sentences.en: Look, if you're making a retro-style 2D pixel-art platformer, do you really need complex material graphs, continuous level of detail for geometry, global illumination, advanced UI, full-fledged 3D physics integrated with inverse kinematics, multiplayer support, etc, etc, etc...?
sentences.zh: 看看，如果你正在制作一款复古风格的 2D 像素艺术平台游戏，你真的需要复杂的材质图、连续的几何细节级别、全局照明、高级 UI、与反向运动学集成的成熟 3D 物理、多人游戏支持等等，等等......？

sentences.en: You don't.
sentences.zh: 你不知道。

sentences.en: The only things you'd need are handling user input, showing images on the screen, and probably some audio.
sentences.zh: 您唯一需要的就是处理用户输入、在屏幕上显示图像，可能还需要一些音频。

sentences.en: That's about 2 to 30 days of work, depending on your experience and stubbornness.
sentences.zh: 这大约需要 2 到 30 天的工作时间，具体取决于您的经验和固执程度。

sentences.en: In any case that will be only 1% of your work; the other 99% are making the actual goddamn game.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这只是你工作的 1%；其他 99% 正在制作真正的该死的游戏。

blocks.html_en: See what the brilliant @Eniko has to say on the matter, by the way.

sentences.en: See what the brilliant @Eniko has to say on the matter, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便看看才华横溢的@Eniko 对此事的看法。

blocks.html_en: But what if you want to make the next AAA hit with top notch graphics, physics, and whatnot? Well, then you need all those numerous complex features. The other thing you need is at least 5 spare years of your life to work full-time on your engine to implement all that stuff.

sentences.en: But what if you want to make the next AAA hit with top notch graphics, physics, and whatnot?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果您想制作下一款具有一流图形、物理效果等的 AAA 级热门游戏，该怎么办？

sentences.en: Well, then you need all those numerous complex features.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么您需要所有这些众多的复杂功能。

sentences.en: The other thing you need is at least 5 spare years of your life to work full-time on your engine to implement all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 您需要的另一件事是至少有 5 年的空闲时间来全职研究您的引擎来实现所有这些东西。

blocks.html_en: My points here are:

sentences.en: My points here are:
sentences.zh: 我的观点是：

blocks.html_en: • Game engines can (and, in most cases, should) be small. Small game engines are still game engines.

sentences.en: Game engines can (and, in most cases, should) be small.
sentences.zh: 游戏引擎可以（并且在大多数情况下应该）很小。

blocks.html_en: Strictly speaking, conventional programming isn't required for game logic. Visual scripting has been around for decades, and enables one to implement complex logic without writing any code at all.

sentences.en: Strictly speaking, conventional programming isn't required for game logic.

blocks.html_en: Some people confronted me with strong opinions that visual scripting is also a type of programming. And, well, surely it is! Also drawing black and white squares, as well as doing simple arithmetics on large numbers are also types of programming. That's really not the point here.

sentences.en: However, supporting visual scripting in your engine requires writing specialized tools, which noticeably complicates the engine development.

blocks.html_en: You might also get away with supporting scripting in some language other than what the engine is written in (e.g. a C++ engine with Lua scripting and no direct C++ interface), but if you're already writing an engine, it's probably easier to simply provide a native API (i.e. in the language the engine itself is written with).

blocks.html_en: Most games need a window to run in. Even web games aren't an exception: the window may be the whole web page, or a certain canvas element the game is running in, etc. Probably the only exception are terminal-based games which use the terminal for all input and output (e.g. std::cin/cout in C++).

sentences.en: Most games need a window to run in.

These plaftorm-specific interfaces are typically quite ugly and non-beginner-friendly, and you'll have to re-write the window creation code separately for each platform you're planning to support. Though, in most cases you also need a few extra things from the window, like a graphics API context, which is also created using ugly platform-specific interfaces.

blocks.html_en: How exactly you expose a window in your engine's API is completely up to you and your programming taste. Maybe you'd have a base engine::window class that the engine's user has to subclass. The possibilities are numerous, and, for most part, they don't matter much.

blocks.html_en: One of the things we typically do on each iteration of the game loop is process the player's input. blocks.html_en: How does the engine react to events? Many possibilities here, again. Maybe it just exposes the underlying getNextEvent() function. Maybe it has special code for certain events, like updating the OpenGL viewport when the window is resized, pausing the game when the window is out of focus, or quitting the game when the window is closed. So many possibilities!

blocks.html_en: The more special events the engine handles by itself, the easier it is to use the engine, but in some cases the engine's user might want to override this behavior (like not quitting when requested, which is a deadly sin by the way), so you might want to support overriding the default behavior in your engine.

sentences.en: The more special events the engine handles by itself, the easier it is to use the engine, but in some cases the engine's user might want to override this behavior (like not quitting when requested, which is a deadly sin by the way), so you might want to support overriding the default behavior in your engine.
sentences.zh: 引擎本身处理的特殊事件越多，使用引擎就越容易，但在某些情况下，引擎的用户可能希望覆盖此行为（例如在请求时不退出，顺便说一句，这是一个致命的罪过），因此您可能希望支持覆盖引擎中的默认行为。

blocks.html_en: Graphics

sentences.en: Graphics
sentences.zh: 图形

blocks.html_en: Now we have a window and can react to user's mouse and keyboard, but we can't show our reaction. Time to do some graphics.

sentences.en: Now we have a window and can react to user's mouse and keyboard, but we can't show our reaction.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了一个窗口，可以对用户的鼠标和键盘做出反应，但我们无法显示我们的反应。

sentences.en: Time to do some graphics.
sentences.zh: 是时候做一些图形了。

blocks.html_en: Most window-creation libraries like SDL2 have some built-in 2D graphics support: you can draw on the window by simply filling in the pixels with your favourite colors.

sentences.en: Most window-creation libraries like SDL2 have some built-in 2D graphics support: you can draw on the window by simply filling in the pixels with your favourite colors.
sentences.zh: 大多数窗口创建库（如 SDL2）都有一些内置的 2D 图形支持：您只需用您喜欢的颜色填充像素即可在窗口上绘图。

blocks.html_en: Directly setting pixel colors is quite a minimalistic API which won't be enough in most cases. What will be enough, then? There is no single answer here.

sentences.en: Directly setting pixel colors is quite a minimalistic API which won't be enough in most cases.
sentences.zh: 直接设置像素颜色是一个非常简单的 API，在大多数情况下还不够。

sentences.en: What will be enough, then?
sentences.zh: 那么什么才足够呢？

sentences.en: There is no single answer here.
sentences.zh: 这里没有单一的答案。

blocks.html_en: Maybe your engine is specialized on 2D sprite-based games. In this case, you probably need to expose a drawSprite(image,x,y) function. It might also support some effects, like scaling or rotating the sprite, or applying color modification (blending with some fixed color, desaturation, etc). Internally it might be implemented manually, by computing the resulting pixels and putting them on the screen. It might be implemented using some other graphics library like e.g. cairo. It might be implemented on top of a low-level API like OpenGL. It's up to you and your engine's constraints.

sentences.en: Maybe your engine is specialized on 2D sprite-based games.
sentences.zh: 也许您的引擎专门用于基于 2D 精灵的游戏。

sentences.en: In this case, you probably need to expose a drawSprite(image,x,y) function.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，您可能需要公开一个drawSprite(image,x,y)函数。

sentences.en: It might also support some effects, like scaling or rotating the sprite, or applying color modification (blending with some fixed color, desaturation, etc).
sentences.zh: 它还可能支持一些效果，例如缩放或旋转精灵，或应用颜色修改（与某些固定颜色混合、去饱和度等）。

sentences.en: Internally it might be implemented manually, by computing the resulting pixels and putting them on the screen.
sentences.zh: 在内部，它可以通过计算结果像素并将其放置在屏幕上来手动实现。

sentences.en: It might be implemented using some other graphics library like e.g. cairo.
sentences.zh: 它可以使用其他一些图形库来实现，例如开罗。

sentences.en: It might be implemented on top of a low-level API like OpenGL.
sentences.zh: 它可以在 OpenGL 等低级 API 之上实现。

sentences.en: It's up to you and your engine's constraints.
sentences.zh: 这取决于您和您的引擎的限制。

blocks.html_en: Maybe your engine is specialized on simple 3D graphics, in which case it probably needs a much more elaborate interface like rendering 3D meshes with arbitrary affine transformations, changing lighting settings, or supporting animated meshes. This will most probably be implemented on top of a low-level graphics API like OpenGL, Vulkan, Direct3D or WebGPU.

sentences.en: Maybe your engine is specialized on simple 3D graphics, in which case it probably needs a much more elaborate interface like rendering 3D meshes with arbitrary affine transformations, changing lighting settings, or supporting animated meshes.
sentences.zh: 也许您的引擎专门用于简单的 3D 图形，在这种情况下，它可能需要更复杂的界面，例如使用任意仿射变换渲染 3D 网格、更改照明设置或支持动画网格。

sentences.en: This will most probably be implemented on top of a low-level graphics API like OpenGL, Vulkan, Direct3D or WebGPU.
sentences.zh: 这很可能在 OpenGL、Vulkan、Direct3D 或 WebGPU 等低级图形 API 之上实现。

blocks.html_en: Or maybe your engine isn't specialized at all, and provides some generic helpers that can be used for any type of graphics. That's what my engine does: it exposes a nice wrapper on top of OpenGL 3.3 (and now also on top of WebGPU!), but it doesn't contain a rendering engine in it's usual form. Instead, I tend to reimplement the graphics engine for each project separately, which gives me the freedom to experiment with graphics as much as I want. It does include a very simple 2D rendering engine, though, initially intended for debug use but now I'm often making jam games with it :)

sentences.en: Or maybe your engine isn't specialized at all, and provides some generic helpers that can be used for any type of graphics.
sentences.zh: 或者也许您的引擎根本不专业，并且提供了一些可用于任何类型图形的通用帮助程序。

sentences.en: That's what my engine does: it exposes a nice wrapper on top of OpenGL 3.3 (and now also on top of WebGPU!), but it doesn't contain a rendering engine in it's usual form.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的引擎所做的：它在 OpenGL 3.3 之上公开了一个很好的包装器（现在也在 WebGPU 之上！），但它不包含通常形式的渲染引擎。

sentences.en: Instead, I tend to reimplement the graphics engine for each project separately, which gives me the freedom to experiment with graphics as much as I want.
sentences.zh: 相反，我倾向于分别为每个项目重新实现图形引擎，这使我可以自由地随心所欲地尝试图形。

sentences.en: It does include a very simple 2D rendering engine, though, initially intended for debug use but now I'm often making jam games with it :)
sentences.zh: 它确实包含一个非常简单的 2D 渲染引擎，最初是为了调试使用，但现在我经常用它制作果酱游戏:)

blocks.html_en: In any case, you'd probably also want to render some text on the screen, for UI and debug information. This can be done using any rendering backend, but you'll probably want a font loading library like FreeType or even a professional text shaping library like harfbuzz. (Also watch this video by the brillian Sebastian Lague and convince yourself to never write your own font loading library). Or maybe you'll just use a fixed ASCII-only bitmap font :) Though, in this case localization can be harder (imagine supporting Chinese in your font!).

sentences.en: In any case, you'd probably also want to render some text on the screen, for UI and debug information.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，您可能还想在屏幕上呈现一些文本，以获取 UI 和调试信息。

sentences.en: This can be done using any rendering backend, but you'll probably want a font loading library like FreeType or even a professional text shaping library like harfbuzz.
sentences.zh: 这可以使用任何渲染后端来完成，但您可能需要像 FreeType 这样的字体加载库，甚至像 harfbuzz 这样的专业文本整形库。

sentences.en: (Also watch this video by the brillian Sebastian Lague and convince yourself to never write your own font loading library).
sentences.zh: （另请观看精彩的 Sebastian Lague 的这段视频，并说服自己永远不要编写自己的字体加载库）。

sentences.en: Or maybe you'll just use a fixed ASCII-only bitmap font :) Though, in this case localization can be harder (imagine supporting Chinese in your font!).
sentences.zh: 或者您可能只使用固定的纯 ASCII 位图字体:) 不过，在这种情况下本地化可能会更困难（想象一下您的字体支持中文！）。

blocks.html_en: Audio

Outputting audio is done using – you guessed it – ugly platform-specific API's. Alternatively you can take some library that hides that for you, like OpenAL or SDL2_Audio. I'm using the latter, by the way.

sentences.en: Outputting audio is done using – you guessed it – ugly platform-specific API's.
sentences.zh: 输出音频是使用（你猜对了）丑陋的特定于平台的 API 来完成的。

sentences.en: Alternatively you can take some library that hides that for you, like OpenAL or SDL2_Audio.
sentences.zh: 或者，您可以使用一些为您隐藏该内容的库，例如 OpenAL 或 SDL2_Audio。

sentences.en: I'm using the latter, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我正在使用后者。

blocks.html_en: These libraries typically expect you to setup an audio callback – a function that will be called many times per second, typically from a separate audio thread, and is expected to provide audio samples in some format. The rest is up to you: maybe you only need to play a single background music stream, and that's it. More realistically though, you'll probably want several separate streams: one for music, one for effects, one for voice, etc. Then you'll also want to control their volume separately, or maybe apply other, more sophisticated effets. Oh, and you'll absolutely want a compressor on top of the final output, which prevents clicks and noise when many sounds are playing simultaneously. All this is done via an audio mixing library.

sentences.en: These libraries typically expect you to setup an audio callback – a function that will be called many times per second, typically from a separate audio thread, and is expected to provide audio samples in some format.
sentences.zh: 这些库通常期望您设置一个音频回调 - 每秒调用多次的函数，通常来自单独的音频线程，并且期望以某种格式提供音频样本。

sentences.en: The rest is up to you: maybe you only need to play a single background music stream, and that's it.
sentences.zh: 剩下的就取决于你了：也许你只需要播放一个背景音乐流，仅此而已。

sentences.en: More realistically though, you'll probably want several separate streams: one for music, one for effects, one for voice, etc. Then you'll also want to control their volume separately, or maybe apply other, more sophisticated effets.
sentences.zh: 但更现实的是，您可能需要几个单独的流：一个用于音乐，一个用于效果，一个用于语音等。然后您还需要单独控制它们的音量，或者可能应用其他更复杂的效果。

sentences.en: Oh, and you'll absolutely want a compressor on top of the final output, which prevents clicks and noise when many sounds are playing simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 哦，您绝对需要在最终输出之上安装一个压缩器，这样可以在许多声音同时播放时防止咔嗒声和噪音。

sentences.en: All this is done via an audio mixing library.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是通过音频混合库完成的。

blocks.html_en: My engine has it's own audio mixing library, and I've written a giant blog post about its design and implementation. In short, it operates on highly abstract audio streams and allows you to combine them however you want to make new streams, and expects you to plug a single output stream as the final played audio. One person even integrated it in their own game engine :)

sentences.en: My engine has it's own audio mixing library, and I've written a giant blog post about its design and implementation.
sentences.zh: 我的引擎有它自己的音频混合库，我写了一篇关于它的设计和实现的巨大博客文章。

sentences.en: In short, it operates on highly abstract audio streams and allows you to combine them however you want to make new streams, and expects you to plug a single output stream as the final played audio.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，它对高度抽象的音频流进行操作，并允许您以任意方式组合它们以创建新的流，并期望您插入单个输出流作为最终播放的音频。

sentences.en: One person even integrated it in their own game engine :)
sentences.zh: 有人甚至将其集成到自己的游戏引擎中:)

blocks.html_en: You can do this all yourself, or you could find a library that does audio mixing for you. I'm sure there are hundreds of them, but I didn't conduct a thorough search.

sentences.en: You can do this all yourself, or you could find a library that does audio mixing for you.
sentences.zh: 您可以自己完成这一切，或者您可以找到一个为您进行音频混合的库。

sentences.en: I'm sure there are hundreds of them, but I didn't conduct a thorough search.
sentences.zh: 我确信有数百个，但我没有进行彻底的搜索。

blocks.html_en: Assets

sentences.en: Assets
sentences.zh: 资产

blocks.html_en: Assets are all your game's sprites, textures, audio files, 3D models, levels, AI scripts, etc. Again, there are many ways to handle them.

sentences.en: Assets are all your game's sprites, textures, audio files, 3D models, levels, AI scripts, etc. Again, there are many ways to handle them.
sentences.zh: 资产是游戏的所有精灵、纹理、音频文件、3D 模型、关卡、AI 脚本等。同样，有很多方法可以处理它们。

blocks.html_en: You could turn them into binary data compiled into your game executable. The advantage is that you don't have to think about loading assets – they are right here, accessible in code as a raw byte array immediately. The downside is that you can't change assets without recompiling the game, which might be an issue (I typically maintain good compile times, which is why I used this method for quite a long time). Another downside is that this approach makes modding almost impossible.

sentences.en: You could turn them into binary data compiled into your game executable.
sentences.zh: 您可以将它们转换为编译到游戏可执行文件中的二进制数据。

sentences.en: The advantage is that you don't have to think about loading assets – they are right here, accessible in code as a raw byte array immediately.
sentences.zh: 优点是您不必考虑加载资源 - 它们就在这里，可以立即在代码中作为原始字节数组进行访问。

sentences.en: The downside is that you can't change assets without recompiling the game, which might be an issue (I typically maintain good compile times, which is why I used this method for quite a long time).
sentences.zh: 缺点是您无法在不重新编译游戏的情况下更改资源，这可能是一个问题（我通常保持良好的编译时间，这就是我使用这种方法很长一段时间的原因）。

sentences.en: Another downside is that this approach makes modding almost impossible.
sentences.zh: 另一个缺点是这种方法几乎不可能进行改装。

blocks.html_en: You could store assets simply as files, in some assets folder next to your game's executable. An asset manager in your code then simply loads this files, and maybe does some caching or preprocessing. This approach is probably the best for modding, and the easiest one during development.

sentences.en: You could store assets simply as files, in some assets folder next to your game's executable.
sentences.zh: 您可以将资产简单地作为文件存储在游戏可执行文件旁边的某个资产文件夹中。

sentences.en: An asset manager in your code then simply loads this files, and maybe does some caching or preprocessing.
sentences.zh: 然后，代码中的资产管理器只需加载此文件，并且可能会进行一些缓存或预处理。

sentences.en: This approach is probably the best for modding, and the easiest one during development.
sentences.zh: 这种方法可能是最适合改装的方法，也是开发过程中最简单的方法。

blocks.html_en: You could store assets in an archive, be it some widespread format like ZIP or some ad-hoc format tailored to your engine's needs (the latter seems to be the method of choice for most big engines).

sentences.en: You could store assets in an archive, be it some widespread format like ZIP or some ad-hoc format tailored to your engine's needs (the latter seems to be the method of choice for most big engines).
sentences.zh: 您可以将资源存储在存档中，无论是 ZIP 等广泛使用的格式，还是根据您的引擎需求量身定制的特殊格式（后者似乎是大多数大型引擎的选择方法）。

blocks.html_en: In any case, you'll probably want to use some format-specific libraries to turn the raw asset bytes into usable data, like e.g. stb_image for loading images or RapidJSON for loading some JSON entity descriptions.

sentences.en: In any case, you'll probably want to use some format-specific libraries to turn the raw asset bytes into usable data, like e.g. stb_image for loading images or RapidJSON for loading some JSON entity descriptions.
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下，您可能希望使用一些特定于格式的库将原始资产字节转换为可用数据，例如stb_image 用于加载图像或 RapidJSON 用于加载一些 JSON 实体描述。

blocks.html_en: You could also support hot-realoading assets, though this quickly becomes a much more complicated thing.

sentences.en: You could also support hot-realoading assets, though this quickly becomes a much more complicated thing.
sentences.zh: 您还可以支持热重载资源，尽管这很快就会变得更加复杂。

blocks.html_en: Physics

sentences.en: Physics
sentences.zh: 物理

blocks.html_en: Now, most games actually don't need any physics. They need animation, logic, and other stuff that might resemble physics, but not actual physics. Civilization 6 doesn't have physics, for instance. Nor do most city-building games.

sentences.en: Now, most games actually don't need any physics.
sentences.zh: 现在，大多数游戏实际上不需要任何物理。

sentences.en: They need animation, logic, and other stuff that might resemble physics, but not actual physics.
sentences.zh: 他们需要动画、逻辑和其他可能类似于物理的东西，但不是实际的物理。

sentences.en: Civilization 6 doesn't have physics, for instance.
sentences.zh: 例如，《文明 6》就没有物理学。

sentences.en: Nor do most city-building games.
sentences.zh: 大多数城市建设游戏也没有。

blocks.html_en: If you're making something like a platformer, or a top-down 2D RPG, all your physics will boil down to character movement, and maybe some very basic collisions. These are relatively easy to write, and more importantly this way they are much easier to tweak to your specific needs than some big generic physics engine.

sentences.en: If you're making something like a platformer, or a top-down 2D RPG, all your physics will boil down to character movement, and maybe some very basic collisions.
sentences.zh: 如果您正在制作类似平台游戏或自上而下的 2D RPG 之类的东西，那么您所有的物理特性都将归结为角色移动，也许还有一些非常基本的碰撞。

sentences.en: These are relatively easy to write, and more importantly this way they are much easier to tweak to your specific needs than some big generic physics engine.
sentences.zh: 这些相对容易编写，更重要的是，与某些大型通用物理引擎相比，它们更容易根据您的特定需求进行调整。

blocks.html_en: If you have too many collisions, you can optimize them with spatial hashing or quadtrees. And if you're scared of quadtrees, you shouldn't be: I've written a blog post about how to implement them in a few dozen lines of code.

sentences.en: If you have too many collisions, you can optimize them with spatial hashing or quadtrees.
sentences.zh: 如果冲突太多，可以使用空间哈希或四叉树来优化它们。

sentences.en: And if you're scared of quadtrees, you shouldn't be: I've written a blog post about how to implement them in a few dozen lines of code.
sentences.zh: 如果您害怕四叉树，您不应该害怕：我写了一篇关于如何用几十行代码实现它们的博客文章。

blocks.html_en: Anyway, if you are absolutely sure you need real physics, take some library like Box2D or Bullet. By the way, Erin Catto, the creator of Box2D, has tons of materials online on how to implement physics engines (specifically, impulse-based constraint resolution).

sentences.en: Anyway, if you are absolutely sure you need real physics, take some library like Box2D or Bullet.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，如果你绝对确定你需要真实的物理，请使用像 Box2D 或 Bullet 这样的库。

sentences.en: By the way, Erin Catto, the creator of Box2D, has tons of materials online on how to implement physics engines (specifically, impulse-based constraint resolution).
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，Box2D 的创建者 Erin Catto 在网上有大量关于如何实现物理引擎（特别是基于脉冲的约束解析）的材料。

blocks.html_en: Scripting

sentences.en: Scripting
sentences.zh: 脚本编写

blocks.html_en: First, what is scripting? Let's define it as support for programming parts of the game in a programming language other than the one the engine is written in.

sentences.en: First, what is scripting?
sentences.zh: 首先，什么是脚本？

sentences.en: Let's define it as support for programming parts of the game in a programming language other than the one the engine is written in.
sentences.zh: 我们将其定义为对使用引擎编写语言以外的编程语言对游戏部分进行编程的支持。

blocks.html_en: Again, not all games or game engines need scripting. After all, you're already programming, say, in C++, why use a whole new language for some parts of the game? Here are a few possible reasons:

sentences.en: Again, not all games or game engines need scripting.
sentences.zh: 同样，并非所有游戏或游戏引擎都需要脚本。

sentences.en: After all, you're already programming, say, in C++, why use a whole new language for some parts of the game?
sentences.zh: 毕竟，您已经在使用 C++ 等进行编程了，为什么要在游戏的某些部分使用全新的语言呢？

sentences.en: Here are a few possible reasons:
sentences.zh: 以下是一些可能的原因：

blocks.html_en: • Developers are typically more productive in some scripting language than in a low-level one like C++ (David Frampton, the creator of Sapiens, said in his devlogs that supporting Lua scripting made him orders of magnitude more productive)

sentences.en: Developers are typically more productive in some scripting language than in a low-level one like C++ (David Frampton, the creator of Sapiens, said in his devlogs that supporting Lua scripting made him orders of magnitude more productive)
sentences.zh: 开发人员使用某些脚本语言通常比使用 C++ 等低级语言更具生产力（Sapiens 的创建者 David Frampton 在他的开发博客中表示，支持 Lua 脚本使他的生产力提高了几个数量级）

blocks.html_en: • It is easier to run code in some protected environment if they are written in a scripting language

sentences.en: It is easier to run code in some protected environment if they are written in a scripting language
sentences.zh: 如果代码是用脚本语言编写的，则在某些受保护的环境中运行代码会更容易

blocks.html_en: • It is easier to support hot-reloading code in an interpreted or JIT-compiled scripting language than in a low-level compiled language (though it is still very much possible)

sentences.en: It is easier to support hot-reloading code in an interpreted or JIT-compiled scripting language than in a low-level compiled language (though it is still very much possible)
sentences.zh: 与低级编译语言相比，解释型或 JIT 编译脚本语言更容易支持热重载代码（尽管这仍然很有可能）

blocks.html_en: • It is easier for modders to write stuff in a scripting language

sentences.en: It is easier for modders to write stuff in a scripting language
sentences.zh: 模组作者用脚本语言编写东西更容易

blocks.html_en: Lua is a pretty popular choice for scripting: it is a very simple yet powerful language. Godot engine has it's own language GDScript. You could probably use Python or even JavaScript as your scripting language.

sentences.en: Lua is a pretty popular choice for scripting: it is a very simple yet powerful language.
sentences.zh: Lua 是一种非常流行的脚本选择：它是一种非常简单但功能强大的语言。

sentences.en: Godot engine has it's own language GDScript.
sentences.zh: Godot 引擎有自己的语言 GDScript。

sentences.en: You could probably use Python or even JavaScript as your scripting language.
sentences.zh: 您可以使用 Python 甚至 JavaScript 作为脚本语言。

blocks.html_en: Still, bear in mind that not every game needs this.

sentences.en: Still, bear in mind that not every game needs this.
sentences.zh: 不过，请记住，并不是每个游戏都需要这个。

blocks.html_en: Networking

sentences.en: Networking
sentences.zh: 联网

blocks.html_en: As usual, everything depends on your particular needs. Maybe you don't intend to make multiplayer games, or any games whatsoever that use the network.

sentences.en: As usual, everything depends on your particular needs.
sentences.zh: 像往常一样，一切都取决于您的特定需求。

sentences.en: Maybe you don't intend to make multiplayer games, or any games whatsoever that use the network.
sentences.zh: 也许您不打算制作多人游戏或任何使用网络的游戏。

blocks.html_en: Or maybe you do! In this case, your programming language's standard library probably already has some asynchronous socket abstractions; or, if you're using C++, I recommend Boost.Asio (if you're allergic to Boost, take the standalone Asio version).

sentences.en: Or maybe you do!
sentences.zh: 或者也许你会！

sentences.en: In this case, your programming language's standard library probably already has some asynchronous socket abstractions; or, if you're using C++, I recommend Boost.Asio (if you're allergic to Boost, take the standalone Asio version).
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，您的编程语言的标准库可能已经有一些异步套接字抽象；或者，如果您使用 C++，我推荐 Boost.Asio（如果您对 Boost 过敏，请使用独立的 Asio 版本）。

blocks.html_en: That's still not quite networking support, though. And, to be honest, I have no idea what constitutes such support, as I've never written multiplayer games apart from a couple of silly prototypes that I tested with my friends. Maybe have a look at what your favourite big game engine does in terms of networking, or maybe look at some open-source stuff like Valve's GameNetworkingSockets.

sentences.en: That's still not quite networking support, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这仍然不完全是网络支持。

sentences.en: And, to be honest, I have no idea what constitutes such support, as I've never written multiplayer games apart from a couple of silly prototypes that I tested with my friends.
sentences.zh: 而且，说实话，我不知道这种支持是什么，因为除了我和朋友一起测试的几个愚蠢的原型之外，我从未编写过多人游戏。

sentences.en: Maybe have a look at what your favourite big game engine does in terms of networking, or maybe look at some open-source stuff like Valve's GameNetworkingSockets.
sentences.zh: 也许看看你最喜欢的大型游戏引擎在网络方面的作用，或者看看一些开源的东西，比如 Valve 的 GameNetworkingSockets。

blocks.html_en: AI

You wouldn't believe me, but not every game needs AI. And those that do often really need just a few scripts. In fact, in general AI is just code, so, if your engine supports writing code, it has AI support! Yay!

sentences.en: You wouldn't believe me, but not every game needs AI.
sentences.zh: 你可能不会相信我，但并不是所有游戏都需要人工智能。

sentences.en: And those that do often really need just a few scripts.
sentences.zh: 而那些通常确实只需要几个脚本的人。

sentences.en: In fact, in general AI is just code, so, if your engine supports writing code, it has AI support!
sentences.zh: 事实上，一般来说人工智能只是代码，所以，如果你的引擎支持编写代码，它就有人工智能支持！

sentences.en: Yay!
sentences.zh: 耶！

blocks.html_en: Though you might want something more here, like support for a specific AI programming pattern, like behavior trees, or goal-driven AI, or something else. By the way, watch Bobby Anguelov's talk about game AI approaches.

sentences.en: Though you might want something more here, like support for a specific AI programming pattern, like behavior trees, or goal-driven AI, or something else.
sentences.zh: 尽管您可能想要更多的东西，比如支持特定的人工智能编程模式，比如行为树，或目标驱动的人工智能，或其他东西。

sentences.en: By the way, watch Bobby Anguelov's talk about game AI approaches.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，观看 Bobby Anguelov 谈论游戏 AI 方法。

blocks.html_en: I've written a blog post about the design of my own behavior trees library, if you're interested. I think the library itself is good, but the whole behavior trees approach has its drawbacks.

sentences.en: I've written a blog post about the design of my own behavior trees library, if you're interested.
sentences.zh: 如果您有兴趣，我已经写了一篇关于我自己的行为树库设计的博客文章。

sentences.en: I think the library itself is good, but the whole behavior trees approach has its drawbacks.
sentences.zh: 我认为库本身很好，但整个行为树方法有其缺点。

blocks.html_en: UI

I'd argue that almost every game needs UI. However, UI is really just some objects that react to user's input and draw something on the screen, so they don't seem to be that different from the rest of the engine. Why have a dedicated UI library?

sentences.en: I'd argue that almost every game needs UI.
sentences.zh: 我认为几乎每个游戏都需要 UI。

sentences.en: However, UI is really just some objects that react to user's input and draw something on the screen, so they don't seem to be that different from the rest of the engine.
sentences.zh: 然而，UI 实际上只是一些对用户输入做出反应并在屏幕上绘制内容的对象，因此它们似乎与引擎的其余部分没有什么不同。

sentences.en: Why have a dedicated UI library?
sentences.zh: 为什么要有专门的 UI 库？

blocks.html_en: Well, UI is usually structured differently to typical game entities, and behaves differently. It exists in the window coordinate system, not the world coordinates that all your game objects are in. It has some typical expected behavior, like a button should react to being hovered by the mouse or being clicked on, a slider is expected to behave accordingly, etc. Still, abstracting all this in a reusable way is a very complicated task. Reimplementing UI from scratch in every project may turn out to be simpler for you than adding UI support in the engine.

sentences.en: Well, UI is usually structured differently to typical game entities, and behaves differently.
sentences.zh: 嗯，UI 的结构通常与典型的游戏实体不同，并且行为也不同。

sentences.en: It exists in the window coordinate system, not the world coordinates that all your game objects are in.
sentences.zh: 它存在于窗口坐标系中，而不是所有游戏对象所在的世界坐标系中。

sentences.en: It has some typical expected behavior, like a button should react to being hovered by the mouse or being clicked on, a slider is expected to behave accordingly, etc. Still, abstracting all this in a reusable way is a very complicated task.
sentences.zh: 它有一些典型的预期行为，比如按钮应该对鼠标悬停或单击做出反应，滑块应该做出相应的行为，等等。尽管如此，以可重用的方式抽象所有这些是一项非常复杂的任务。

sentences.en: Reimplementing UI from scratch in every project may turn out to be simpler for you than adding UI support in the engine.
sentences.zh: 对您来说，在每个项目中从头开始重新实现 UI 可能比在引擎中添加 UI 支持更简单。

blocks.html_en: You wouldn't believe that, but I've written a blog post about my own UI library. This is mostly a rant about how bad it is, though; I'm currently designing a new one, and I'm hoping to get it working somewhere in 2024.

sentences.en: You wouldn't believe that, but I've written a blog post about my own UI library.
sentences.zh: 您可能不会相信，但我已经写了一篇关于我自己的 UI 库的博客文章。

sentences.en: This is mostly a rant about how bad it is, though; I'm currently designing a new one, and I'm hoping to get it working somewhere in 2024.
sentences.zh: 不过，这主要是对情况有多糟糕的咆哮。我目前正在设计一款新产品，希望能在 2024 年投入使用。

blocks.html_en: Architecture

sentences.en: Architecture
sentences.zh: 建筑学

blocks.html_en: Okay, we've been speaking a lot about some isolated libraries, but now we need to tie them all together. Or, do we?

sentences.en: Okay, we've been speaking a lot about some isolated libraries, but now we need to tie them all together.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们已经讨论了很多孤立的库，但现在我们需要将它们连接在一起。

sentences.en: Or, do we?
sentences.zh: 或者，我们呢？

blocks.html_en: My own engine doesn't have any specific arhitecture other than being just a set of libraries. You create a project, you take the libraries you need, and they do what they do. They are designed to be as isolated and independent as possible (within reason, of course). This is nice and quite easy to use.

sentences.en: My own engine doesn't have any specific arhitecture other than being just a set of libraries.
sentences.zh: 我自己的引擎除了一组库之外没有任何特定的体系结构。

sentences.en: You create a project, you take the libraries you need, and they do what they do.
sentences.zh: 您创建一个项目，获取所需的库，然后它们就完成它们所做的事情。

sentences.en: They are designed to be as isolated and independent as possible (within reason, of course).
sentences.zh: 它们被设计为尽可能隔离和独立（当然，在合理范围内）。

sentences.en: This is nice and quite easy to use.
sentences.zh: 这很好而且很容易使用。

blocks.html_en: However, many engines impose a more monolithic architecture, like having a base Object class that all game systems should subclass, some global object manager, and whatnot. This is great for big engines that provide detailed introspection and modification tools, but I doubt it is useful for small engines.

sentences.en: However, many engines impose a more monolithic architecture, like having a base Object class that all game systems should subclass, some global object manager, and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多引擎强加了更加单一的架构，比如拥有一个所有游戏系统都应该子类化的基本对象类、一些全局对象管理器等等。

sentences.en: This is great for big engines that provide detailed introspection and modification tools, but I doubt it is useful for small engines.
sentences.zh: 这对于提供详细自省和修改工具的大型引擎来说非常有用，但我怀疑它对于小型引擎是否有用。

blocks.html_en: Tools

Speaking of tools, – you guessed it, – not every engine needs them. The only tool I used in my engine was a python script that parsed Blender files and generated a binary file with a 3D mesh in some ad-hoc format. I don't use it anymore, since I've switched to glTF models and I'm genuinely happy with this decision.

sentences.en: Speaking of tools, – you guessed it, – not every engine needs them.
sentences.zh: 说到工具，您猜对了，并不是每个引擎都需要它们。

sentences.en: The only tool I used in my engine was a python script that parsed Blender files and generated a binary file with a 3D mesh in some ad-hoc format.
sentences.zh: 我在引擎中使用的唯一工具是一个 python 脚本，它解析 Blender 文件并生成具有某种特殊格式的 3D 网格的二进制文件。

sentences.en: I don't use it anymore, since I've switched to glTF models and I'm genuinely happy with this decision.
sentences.zh: 我不再使用它，因为我已经切换到 glTF 模型，并且我对这个决定感到非常满意。

blocks.html_en: Most big industrial engines provide special tools, though, typically a big editor which feels like IDE + Blender, and allow you to preview the result of your work very quickly. However, designing and implementing such editors is probably as hard as making a game engine itself; I would definitely not recommend doing this for your small in-house game engine.

sentences.en: Most big industrial engines provide special tools, though, typically a big editor which feels like IDE + Blender, and allow you to preview the result of your work very quickly.
sentences.zh: 不过，大多数大型工业引擎都提供特殊工具，通常是一个大型编辑器，感觉就像 IDE + Blender，并允许您非常快速地预览工作结果。

sentences.en: However, designing and implementing such editors is probably as hard as making a game engine itself; I would definitely not recommend doing this for your small in-house game engine.
sentences.zh: 然而，设计和实现这样的编辑器可能和制作游戏引擎本身一样困难；我绝对不建议为您的小型内部游戏引擎执行此操作。

blocks.html_en: However, making smaller, more specialized tools is definitely a great idea. Maybe you have a special level format for performance reasons and you want to make a tool that converts Blender files to your format and allows to preview them and see changes immediately. Maybe you need some funny texture converter. Maybe you need to validate some of the assets every now and then. Investing time in tools is definitely a good idea, just don't try to make another Unity.

sentences.en: However, making smaller, more specialized tools is definitely a great idea.
sentences.zh: 然而，制造更小、更专业的工具绝对是一个好主意。

sentences.en: Maybe you have a special level format for performance reasons and you want to make a tool that converts Blender files to your format and allows to preview them and see changes immediately.
sentences.zh: 也许出于性能原因您有一个特殊的关卡格式，并且您想要制作一个工具将 Blender 文件转换为您的格式并允许预览它们并立即查看更改。

sentences.en: Maybe you need some funny texture converter.
sentences.zh: 也许您需要一些有趣的纹理转换器。

sentences.en: Maybe you need to validate some of the assets every now and then.
sentences.zh: 也许您需要时不时地验证一些资产。

sentences.en: Investing time in tools is definitely a good idea, just don't try to make another Unity.
sentences.zh: 投入时间在工具上绝对是个好主意，只是不要尝试制作另一个Unity。

blocks.html_en: Distribution

sentences.en: Distribution
sentences.zh: 分配

blocks.html_en: You've made a game engine, you made a simple game in it, and you've sent it to your friend to try. What do you mean, they can't launch it? You did send the executable file and not the source code, did you?

sentences.en: You've made a game engine, you made a simple game in it, and you've sent it to your friend to try.
sentences.zh: 您已经制作了一个游戏引擎，在其中制作了一个简单的游戏，并将其发送给您的朋友来尝试。

sentences.en: What do you mean, they can't launch it?
sentences.zh: 你说他们无法启动它是什么意思？

sentences.en: You did send the executable file and not the source code, did you?
sentences.zh: 您确实发送了可执行文件而不是源代码，是吗？

blocks.html_en: We live in a sad world where programs just don't launch on random computers. They need a lot of other stuf to run. If you're using a language that compiles to native code (files that the operating system can launch without any extra help), you still need to supply the required dynamic libraries. In my case, these are SDL2.dll, libpng.dll, and a few more.

sentences.en: We live in a sad world where programs just don't launch on random computers.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在一个悲伤的世界，程序无法在随机计算机上启动。

sentences.en: They need a lot of other stuf to run.
sentences.zh: 他们需要很多其他东西来运行。

sentences.en: If you're using a language that compiles to native code (files that the operating system can launch without any extra help), you still need to supply the required dynamic libraries.
sentences.zh: 如果您使用的语言可以编译为本机代码（操作系统无需任何额外帮助即可启动的文件），您仍然需要提供所需的动态库。

sentences.en: In my case, these are SDL2.dll, libpng.dll, and a few more.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，这些是 SDL2.dll、libpng.dll 等。

blocks.html_en: If you're using a language that is compiled into bytecode, like Java, you need the thing that runs that bytecode, like JVM. Chances are, the user already has a version of JVM installed on their machine; however, you can't guarantee that. If you're using an interpreted language, like Python, you'll have to ship your game with a Python interpreter. You get the point.

sentences.en: If you're using a language that is compiled into bytecode, like Java, you need the thing that runs that bytecode, like JVM.
sentences.zh: 如果您使用的是编译为字节码的语言（例如 Java），那么您需要运行该字节码的东西，例如 JVM。

sentences.en: Chances are, the user already has a version of JVM installed on their machine; however, you can't guarantee that.
sentences.zh: 用户的机器上可能已经安装了某个版本的 JVM；但是，您不能保证这一点。

sentences.en: If you're using an interpreted language, like Python, you'll have to ship your game with a Python interpreter.
sentences.zh: 如果您使用解释性语言（例如 Python），则必须使用 Python 解释器来发布游戏。

sentences.en: You get the point.
sentences.zh: 你明白了。

blocks.html_en: By the way, even native binaries actually need a special launcher to work. In Linux it is called something like /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, and it does some initialization and loads the required dynamic libraries.

sentences.en: By the way, even native binaries actually need a special launcher to work.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，即使是本机二进制文件实际上也需要特殊的启动器才能工作。

sentences.en: In Linux it is called something like /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, and it does some initialization and loads the required dynamic libraries.
sentences.zh: 在 Linux 中，它的名称类似于 /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2，它会执行一些初始化并加载所需的动态库。

blocks.html_en: Supporting multiple platforms adds more pain, since different platforms have different executable file formats, dynamic library formats, etc. You'll have to compile several different versions of your game, one for each platform. By the way, check out my other post about how I ported my C++ engine to Android.

sentences.en: Supporting multiple platforms adds more pain, since different platforms have different executable file formats, dynamic library formats, etc. You'll have to compile several different versions of your game, one for each platform.
sentences.zh: 支持多个平台会增加更多的痛苦，因为不同的平台有不同的可执行文件格式、动态库格式等。您必须编译游戏的多个不同版本，每个平台一个版本。

sentences.en: By the way, check out my other post about how I ported my C++ engine to Android.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，请查看我的另一篇文章，了解如何将 C++ 引擎移植到 Android。

blocks.html_en: Automating all this is probably the most important thing a game engine can do. I use special Ubuntu docker containers for producing Windows and Linux builds (and the mingw64 compiler to cross-compile to Windows) together with some Bash scripts and CMake wizardry to make all this work. It's a pain to prepare these, but in the end I can consistently package reproducible builds of my projects in a matter of a single command.

sentences.en: Automating all this is probably the most important thing a game engine can do.
sentences.zh: 自动化这一切可能是游戏引擎可以做的最重要的事情。

sentences.en: I use special Ubuntu docker containers for producing Windows and Linux builds (and the mingw64 compiler to cross-compile to Windows) together with some Bash scripts and CMake wizardry to make all this work.
sentences.zh: 我使用特殊的 Ubuntu docker 容器来生成 Windows 和 Linux 版本（以及 mingw64 编译器来交叉编译到 Windows）以及一些 Bash 脚本和 CMake 魔法来完成所有这些工作。

sentences.en: It's a pain to prepare these, but in the end I can consistently package reproducible builds of my projects in a matter of a single command.
sentences.zh: 准备这些是很痛苦的，但最终我可以通过一个命令一致地打包我的项目的可重复构建。

blocks.html_en: Part 3: How do I start?

sentences.en: Part 3: How do I start?
sentences.zh: 第 3 部分：我该如何开始？

blocks.html_en: We've discussed a lot of random stuff that a game engine might or might not have, and at this point the idea of writing a game engine sure does seem quite intimidating. But remember what we've discussed in the beginning of the post: not every game or game engine needs everything. A tiny library that creates a window, provides minimal 2D graphics, and some build scripts that create a distributable ZIP archive of the game is already a very decent engine!

sentences.en: We've discussed a lot of random stuff that a game engine might or might not have, and at this point the idea of writing a game engine sure does seem quite intimidating.
sentences.zh: 我们已经讨论了游戏引擎可能具有或不具有的许多随机内容，在这一点上，编写游戏引擎的想法确实看起来相当令人生畏。

sentences.en: But remember what we've discussed in the beginning of the post: not every game or game engine needs everything.
sentences.zh: 但请记住我们在文章开头讨论的内容：并非每个游戏或游戏引擎都需要一切。

sentences.en: A tiny library that creates a window, provides minimal 2D graphics, and some build scripts that create a distributable ZIP archive of the game is already a very decent engine!
sentences.zh: 一个创建窗口、提供最小 2D 图形的小型库以及一些创建游戏的可分发 ZIP 存档的构建脚本已经是一个非常不错的引擎了！

blocks.html_en: So, how do you start making an engine? My advice is to focus not on making an engine, but on making games instead.

sentences.en: So, how do you start making an engine?
sentences.zh: 那么，如何开始制造发动机呢？

sentences.en: My advice is to focus not on making an engine, but on making games instead.
sentences.zh: 我的建议是不要专注于制作引擎，而是专注于制作游戏。

blocks.html_en: Attend a game jam, make a game from scratch, with no engines. Celebrate your achievement. Take a break.

sentences.en: Attend a game jam, make a game from scratch, with no engines.
sentences.zh: 参加游戏即兴活动，从头开始制作游戏，无需引擎。

sentences.en: Celebrate your achievement.
sentences.zh: 庆祝你的成就。

sentences.en: Take a break.
sentences.zh: 休息一下。

blocks.html_en: Attend another game jam, and make a new game from scratch, without reusing anything you made for the previous game. After a few iterations like this you'll find yourself thinking: gosh it would be nice not to write this bunch of code again an again, I wish I already had it somewhere! That's the birth of your engine.

sentences.en: Attend another game jam, and make a new game from scratch, without reusing anything you made for the previous game.
sentences.zh: 参加另一场游戏嘉年华，从头开始制作一款新游戏，而无需重复使用您为上一款游戏制作的任何内容。

sentences.en: After a few iterations like this you'll find yourself thinking: gosh it would be nice not to write this bunch of code again an again, I wish I already had it somewhere!
sentences.zh: 经过几次这样的迭代之后，您会发现自己在想：天哪，如果不再一次又一次地编写这堆代码就好了，我希望我已经把它放在某个地方了！

sentences.en: That's the birth of your engine.
sentences.zh: 这就是您的发动机的诞生。

blocks.html_en: Look carefully at your code. Think which parts can be isolated and separated to be reused later. Think about how exactly you'd want to use these parts. Extract them into a new project, – this is your engine now. Every time you find yourself writing the same code again and again, put it into the engine, possibly taking care of generalizing this code to make it more reusable, like removing hard-coded settings or unnecessary dependencies and fixing bugs and corner cases.

sentences.en: Look carefully at your code.
sentences.zh: 仔细看看你的代码。

sentences.en: Think which parts can be isolated and separated to be reused later.
sentences.zh: 想想哪些部分可以被隔离和分开以便以后重复使用。

sentences.en: Think about how exactly you'd want to use these parts.
sentences.zh: 考虑一下您到底想如何使用这些部件。

sentences.en: Extract them into a new project, – this is your engine now.
sentences.zh: 将它们提取到一个新项目中——现在这就是您的引擎。

sentences.en: Every time you find yourself writing the same code again and again, put it into the engine, possibly taking care of generalizing this code to make it more reusable, like removing hard-coded settings or unnecessary dependencies and fixing bugs and corner cases.
sentences.zh: 每当您发现自己一次又一次地编写相同的代码时，请将其放入引擎中，可能会负责概括此代码以使其更具可重用性，例如删除硬编码设置或不必要的依赖项以及修复错误和极端情况。

blocks.html_en: Repeat this over and over again, and after some time you'll have a good engine tailored to your specific needs, an engine you know, an engine you're efficient with, an engine which you can enhance at any time.

sentences.en: Repeat this over and over again, and after some time you'll have a good engine tailored to your specific needs, an engine you know, an engine you're efficient with, an engine which you can enhance at any time.
sentences.zh: 一遍又一遍地重复此操作，一段时间后，您将拥有一个适合您的特定需求的良好引擎，一个您熟悉的引擎，一个您可以高效使用的引擎，一个您可以随时增强的引擎。

blocks.html_en: As I've said before, it takes time, it forces you to learn a lot, but the result is more than worth it.

sentences.en: As I've said before, it takes time, it forces you to learn a lot, but the result is more than worth it.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，这需要时间，它迫使你学习很多东西，但结果是值得的。

blocks.html_en: Or, maybe not. After all, it's up to you anyway :)

sentences.en: Or, maybe not.
sentences.zh: 或者，也许不是。

sentences.en: After all, it's up to you anyway :)
sentences.zh: 毕竟，这取决于你:)

所以，你想制作一个游戏引擎


2023 Sep 15

Unity最近的争议引发了关于游戏引擎的激烈争论。 一些人说每个人都应该立即切换到新引擎，而另一些人则回答说切换引擎可能需要几个月甚至几年的时间。 有人说最好的方法是推出自己的游戏引擎，而其他人则指出这不是一个简单的任务。 而且，你知道，每个人都在这里：没有单一的答案，一切都取决于具体情况。 但也许编写自己的引擎并不像听起来那么难？ 无论如何，为什么有人要这么做呢？ 制作游戏引擎意味着什么？

除了我自己的宠物引擎之外，我从未真正使用过任何游戏引擎，到目前为止，我已经慢慢扩展了该引擎（已经有大约 100k LOC），并成功地将其用于十多个即兴游戏和一款发布的商业游戏。 然而，我见过人们使用其他引擎；我见过人们抱怨其他引擎；我见过人们谈论他们自己的引擎；我研究了其他（开源）引擎的源代码。 因此，我相信我对此事有一些话要说，但不可否认的是，我的经验可能有些偏见或非常规。

内容

    第 1 部分：难题

    为什么要开发自己的游戏引擎？

    让我们从房间里的大象开始。 这个问题已经讨论了一遍又一遍，但再讨论一次也没什么坏处。 以下是您想要制作自己的游戏引擎的几个原因：

    • 您可以将自己从有问题的公司决策的负担中解放出来，正如最近发生的事件所表明的那样，这是一件大事
    • 定制游戏引擎是免费的（当然，忽略开发成本——没有什么是真正免费的）
    • 您可以根据自己的需求（或特定项目的需求）优化引擎，包括性能、迭代时间（每个人都喜欢等待着色器重新编译或光照贴图烘焙）、引擎架构（对于具有数百万个飞行物体的游戏，您可能会使用 ECS 而不是传统的场景图）以及许多其他方面
    • 您可以完全控制内部一切的运作方式以及使用的技术
    • 您可以使用您最喜欢的编程语言（尽管可能有一些游戏引擎适用于地球上的每种语言）
    • 您可以拥有更小的发行版大小（我的引擎占用不到 2Mb，其中几乎所有空间都被 SDL2.dll 占用）
    • 你可以开源你的引擎并看到它被其他人使用（但要注意维护 FOSS 项目基本上是地狱）
    • 如果质量合适的话，您甚至可以出售您的引擎（但要注意营销您的作品基本上是地狱）
    • 您不会因为一些愚蠢的开发人员没有实现您需要的功能而感到沮丧
    • 互联网上随机的人会认为你很酷，因为你正在制造自己的引擎
    • 这很有趣，我保证
    • 一路上你会学到很多东西，这会让你更好地理解其他引擎，因此，即使你把自己的引擎扔进垃圾箱，也会帮助你将来制作游戏。

    对我个人来说，最后两点是最重要的。 首先，学习很有趣，如果你不这么认为，你最好开始：如果你想制作游戏，无论如何你都必须学习很多东西，所以最好开始享受这个过程！

    其次，我只是喜欢编码。 我喜欢实现算法，我喜欢设计库和系统，我喜欢挖掘底层的东西。 删除这个会让我的游戏开发变得痛苦。

    我还想详细说明“不会沮丧”这一点，因为这对我来说是一个令人大开眼界的发现。 我一直看到人们抱怨引擎：这个东西坏了，这个东西破坏了其他东西，这个新东西不支持这个旧东西，这个东西是十年前要求的，但仍然没有实现。 当然，事情变成这样总是有原因的。如果您曾经在一家足够大的公司工作过，您可能会产生共鸣。 然而，责备别人总是比责怪自己容易。 那些愚蠢的开发者没有解决这个问题！ 如果您需要的话，为什么不修复它？ 好吧，这不是你的引擎，对吧？ – 这是他们的。 但这是你的挫败感。

    但现在是了，现在你正在制造自己的引擎。 突然间，您不再感到沮丧：您确切地知道为什么引擎缺少您现在需要的某些功能。 你没有实现它，就这么简单。 你为什么不呢？ 嗯，显然你在忙其他事情！ 你独自或在一个小团队中制作一个完整的游戏引擎，引擎缺乏某些东西的支持是可以理解的。 甚至，这是预料之中的。 您将在真正需要时实现该功能。 你当然会的。 只是，可能，不是现在。 还有其他事情。

    我的观点是，因自己的工作而责怪自己比因他人的工作而责怪自己更难。

    为什么不开发自己的游戏引擎呢？

    无论如何，这整个努力肯定有一些缺点：

    • 这既困难又耗时。 我的意思是，当然这取决于您的用例，但不要指望在学习了 3 个月的 C++ 课程后仅一年内就编写了虚幻克隆
    • 你永远无法战胜那些巨大的工业引擎（就像旧的虚幻引擎一样）。 当然，除非您是一个足够大且足够富有的工作室，否则这篇文章可能不适合您
    • 您的引擎将缺乏功能。 需要多年的努力才能实现大型引擎的一小部分功能集和可用性
    • 您可能会发现自己过于深入引擎开发而不是制作实际的游戏，这很容易导致倦怠
    • 互联网上随机的人会认为你是个白痴，因为你正在制造自己的引擎

    请注意，如果您计划正确，制造自己的引擎的成本可以分摊到多个项目中。

    那么，你应该制作一个游戏引擎吗？ 你告诉我吧！ 如果您想尽快制作游戏，只需选择现有的引擎即可。 如果你想成长为一名游戏开发者，保护你未来的项目，并且你有足够的时间，那么就制作一个游戏引擎！ 在任何其他情况下，您都必须自己决定，而不是依赖互联网上的陌生人:)

    什么是游戏引擎？

    好问题！ SDL2 是游戏引擎吗？ 我想说它不是，它实际上是一个平台抽象库。 OpenGL是游戏引擎吗？ 当然不是，它是一个低级图形API。 stb_image 是游戏引擎吗？ 当然不是，它是一个图像加载库。

    现在想象一个结合了 SDL2、OpenGL 和 stb_image 的小项目，让您在屏幕上绘制移动的精灵：这是一个游戏引擎吗？ 听起来确实像一个！

    那么什么是游戏引擎，它与其他库或 API 有何不同？ 是图形、动画和用户输入的组合吗？ 好吧，我的一位亲爱的朋友非常成功地制作了在终端上运行的基于文本的游戏，这些游戏显然缺乏任何图形或动画，但它们是完全有效的游戏。 那么，任何有用户输入的东西都是游戏引擎吗？ 例如，计算器是游戏吗？ 呃，好吧，可能不会，除非你无聊死了。

    我提出以下定义：游戏引擎是任何一组工具、库和其他旨在帮助您制作游戏的东西。 如果您觉得这个定义模糊得难以理解，几乎到了完全无用的程度，那是因为它确实如此。 确实如此，但这就是重点。

    看看，如果你正在制作一款复古风格的 2D 像素艺术平台游戏，你真的需要复杂的材质图、连续的几何细节级别、全局照明、高级 UI、与反向运动学集成的成熟 3D 物理、多人游戏支持等等，等等......？ 你不知道。 您唯一需要的就是处理用户输入、在屏幕上显示图像，可能还需要一些音频。 这大约需要 2 到 30 天的工作时间，具体取决于您的经验和固执程度。 无论如何，这只是你工作的 1%；其他 99% 正在制作真正的该死的游戏。

    顺便看看才华横溢的@Eniko 对此事的看法。

    但是，如果您想制作下一款具有一流图形、物理效果等的 AAA 级热门游戏，该怎么办？ 好吧，那么您需要所有这些众多的复杂功能。 您需要的另一件事是至少有 5 年的空闲时间来全职研究您的引擎来实现所有这些东西。

    我的观点是：

    • 游戏引擎可以（并且在大多数情况下应该）很小。 小游戏引擎仍然是游戏引擎。
    • 游戏引擎差异很大，从单个非常专业的 100 LOC 文件到 100 Gb 工业巨兽。 没有引擎可以满足所有需求，每个游戏都有自己的一套独特的功能和限制。

    对游戏引擎的期望是什么？

    好吧，我对游戏引擎的定义主要是为了让你相信引擎可以很小。 不过，让我们现实一点：大多数足够大的游戏引擎都会出现一些预期的情况，除非它们的设计极其简约或专门化（这是完全正常的事情！）。 仅举几例：

    • 能够对游戏的逻辑进行编程（废话）
    • 创建一个窗口来显示内容
    • 运行处理各种事件的游戏循环
    • 处理用户输入，例如鼠标、键盘、操纵杆或触摸栏
    • 显示某种图形，无论是基于 2D 精灵的图形还是 3D 图形
    • 制作背景音乐和音效等音频
    • 管理图像、模型、音频、预制件或完整游戏关卡等资源
    • 模拟物理，无论是 2D 或 3D、基于位置、基于脉冲或基于力、硬或软
    • 支持快速原型设计或轻松修改的脚本
    • 支持多人联网、自动下载游戏更新或补丁，或启用可下载的用户生成内容
    • 为游戏的敌人或 NPC 实施 AI
    • 为您的游戏华丽的界面实现 UI
    • 建立一个以统一方式连接所有这些部分的架构
    • 提供帮助您使用引擎的工具
    • 负责用该引擎制作的游戏的分发，最好是在多个平台上，最好通过单击按钮来分发

    请注意，您的特定引擎可能只包含这些功能的一小部分，但仍称为游戏引擎。 并不是每个游戏都需要一切。

    现在让我们一一讨论这些功能。

    第 2 部分：游戏引擎功能

    编程

    严格来说，游戏逻辑不需要传统编程。 可视化脚本已经存在了几十年，它使人们无需编写任何代码即可实现复杂的逻辑。

    Visual scripting in Unreal

    有些人强烈反对我，认为可视化脚本也是一种编程。 而且，嗯，确实如此！ 绘制黑白方块以及对大数进行简单算术也是编程的类型。 这确实不是重点。

    然而，在引擎中支持可视化脚本需要编写专门的工具，这明显使引擎开发变得复杂。 而且，在我看来，代码仍然是实现任何类型逻辑的最通用、最通用的方式。

    您也可能会摆脱对引擎编写语言以外的某种语言的脚本支持（例如，具有 Lua 脚本且没有直接 C++ 接口的 C++ 引擎），但如果您已经在编写引擎，那么简单地提供本机 API（即使用引擎本身编写的语言）可能会更容易。

    然而，编写引擎仍然需要编程，这里没有捷径。 那么，哪种语言最适合编写引擎呢？ 老实说，这并不重要，选择你喜欢的语言即可。 我使用 C++ 是因为我已经使用它十五年了，它是我最了解的语言，是我喜欢的语言，并且使用起来很舒服。 如果您对 C++ 过敏，请选择 Rust、C#、Python、Haskell、Java 或其他任何语言。 说真的，没关系。

    在某些时候，您可能需要性能关键的代码，并且大多数语言都有自己的方法来实现这一点。 更接近金属的语言（如 C++ 或 Rust）通常在性能方面更加透明，但同样，您可以使用任何语言来实现。

    在我（可能不是很流行）看来，呈现引擎的最佳方式是作为编程库：您将其作为依赖项包含在游戏项目中，并根据需要使用它。 这可能意味着您需要一些构建系统支持；不过，根据引擎的大小和复杂性，您可能只需要一些 makefile。

    假设您以 C++ 库的形式制作了一个存根（空）引擎，在头文件中提供了引擎的 API，并拥有一些实现该 API 的代码。 您将其打包为 CMake 项目，或者可能提供一些 makefile，或者可能只提供整个源代码，期望引擎的用户将所有源文件添加到游戏项目中。 接下来怎么办？

    窗户

    大多数游戏都需要一个窗口来运行。 即使网页游戏也不例外：窗口可能是整个网页，也可能是游戏运行的某个画布元素等。唯一的例外可能是基于终端的游戏，它们使用终端进行所有输入和输出（例如 C++ 中的 std::cin/cout）。

    创建窗口通常是通过特定于平台的方式完成的，例如使用 WinAPI 中的 CreateWindowEx 函数。 这些特定于平台的界面通常非常丑陋且不适合初学者，并且您必须为您计划支持的每个平台单独重写窗口创建代码。 不过，在大多数情况下，您还需要窗口中的一些额外内容，例如图形 API 上下文，它也是使用丑陋的特定于平台的接口创建的。

    值得庆幸的是，有一些库可以为您完成这一切。 在 C++ 中，您可以使用 SDL2、glfw、sfml 或数千个类似库之一。 只需将它们添加到您的项目中，调用相应的 createWindow() 函数即可完成。 任何其他语言都有类似的库甚至内置工具来执行此操作。

    如何在引擎的 API 中公开窗口完全取决于您和您的编程品味。 也许您有一个 engine::init() 函数来创建一个窗口并将其存储在全局变量中。 也许您有一个显式的 engine::createWindow() 函数，它返回一些表示窗口的对象并允许对其进行进一步的操作。 也许您有一个基本的 engine::window 类，引擎的用户必须对其进行子类化。 可能性有很多，而且在大多数情况下，它们并不重要。

    游戏循环

    这就是几乎所有游戏和游戏引擎的共同点，尽管循环本身可能隐藏在引擎内部很深的地方。 在更高的层面上，游戏的代码如下所示：

    int main()
{
    createWindow();
    setupStuff();
    while (gameIsRunning)
    {
        processInput();
        simulateStuff();
        drawFrame();
    }
}

    这个 while (gameIsRunning) 循环是核心游戏循环。 它是让你的游戏运行的因素，也是为你的游戏添加时间维度的因素。 如果没有它，主函数将简单地返回并且游戏将关闭。

    同样，在引擎的 API 中公开循环有很多可能性。 它可能是完全明确的，即引擎的用户在其主函数中的某处编写 while (engine::isRunning()) 。 它可能隐藏在引擎内部，例如在一些engine::run()函数中，它又调用用户提供的一些函数。 也许用户子类化了一个 engine::application 类，并且必须重写一些从 application.run() 方法调用的 application.update() 方法。

    无论你选择什么，你都需要一个游戏循环。

    用户输入

    我们通常在游戏循环的每次迭代中做的事情之一是处理玩家的输入。 同样，这可以使用丑陋的特定于平台的 API 来完成，但大多数窗口创建库还提供了一种独立于平台的处理用户输入的方式。 它通常被实现为 getNextEvent() 函数（有时称为 pollEvents() 或类似的函数）。

    引擎如何对事件做出反应？ 这里再次有很多可能性。 也许它只是公开了底层的 getNextEvent() 函数。 也许它会自行处理事件，并在途中调用用户的回调，例如 application.onMouseMove(x,y)。 也许它有针对某些事件的特殊代码，例如在调整窗口大小时更新 OpenGL 视口、在窗口失去焦点时暂停游戏或在窗口关闭时退出游戏。 这么多的可能性！

    引擎本身处理的特殊事件越多，使用引擎就越容易，但在某些情况下，引擎的用户可能希望覆盖此行为（例如在请求时不退出，顺便说一句，这是一个致命的罪过），因此您可能希望支持覆盖引擎中的默认行为。

    图形

    现在我们有了一个窗口，可以对用户的鼠标和键盘做出反应，但我们无法显示我们的反应。 是时候做一些图形了。

    大多数窗口创建库（如 SDL2）都有一些内置的 2D 图形支持：您只需用您喜欢的颜色填充像素即可在窗口上绘图。

    直接设置像素颜色是一个非常简单的 API，在大多数情况下还不够。 那么什么才足够呢？ 这里没有单一的答案。

    也许您的引擎专门用于基于 2D 精灵的游戏。 在这种情况下，您可能需要公开一个drawSprite(image,x,y)函数。 它还可能支持一些效果，例如缩放或旋转精灵，或应用颜色修改（与某些固定颜色混合、去饱和度等）。 在内部，它可以通过计算结果像素并将其放置在屏幕上来手动实现。 它可以使用其他一些图形库来实现，例如开罗。 它可以在 OpenGL 等低级 API 之上实现。 这取决于您和您的引擎的限制。

    也许您的引擎专门用于简单的 3D 图形，在这种情况下，它可能需要更复杂的界面，例如使用任意仿射变换渲染 3D 网格、更改照明设置或支持动画网格。 这很可能在 OpenGL、Vulkan、Direct3D 或 WebGPU 等低级图形 API 之上实现。

    或者也许您的引擎根本不专业，并且提供了一些可用于任何类型图形的通用帮助程序。 这就是我的引擎所做的：它在 OpenGL 3.3 之上公开了一个很好的包装器（现在也在 WebGPU 之上！），但它不包含通常形式的渲染引擎。 相反，我倾向于分别为每个项目重新实现图形引擎，这使我可以自由地随心所欲地尝试图形。 它确实包含一个非常简单的 2D 渲染引擎，最初是为了调试使用，但现在我经常用它制作果酱游戏:)

    无论如何，您可能还想在屏幕上呈现一些文本，以获取 UI 和调试信息。 这可以使用任何渲染后端来完成，但您可能需要像 FreeType 这样的字体加载库，甚至像 harfbuzz 这样的专业文本整形库。 （另请观看精彩的 Sebastian Lague 的这段视频，并说服自己永远不要编写自己的字体加载库）。 或者您可能只使用固定的纯 ASCII 位图字体:) 不过，在这种情况下本地化可能会更困难（想象一下您的字体支持中文！）。

    Audio

    输出音频是使用（你猜对了）丑陋的特定于平台的 API 来完成的。 或者，您可以使用一些为您隐藏该内容的库，例如 OpenAL 或 SDL2_Audio。 顺便说一句，我正在使用后者。

    这些库通常期望您设置一个音频回调 - 每秒调用多次的函数，通常来自单独的音频线程，并且期望以某种格式提供音频样本。 剩下的就取决于你了：也许你只需要播放一个背景音乐流，仅此而已。 但更现实的是，您可能需要几个单独的流：一个用于音乐，一个用于效果，一个用于语音等。然后您还需要单独控制它们的音量，或者可能应用其他更复杂的效果。 哦，您绝对需要在最终输出之上安装一个压缩器，这样可以在许多声音同时播放时防止咔嗒声和噪音。 所有这些都是通过音频混合库完成的。

    我的引擎有它自己的音频混合库，我写了一篇关于它的设计和实现的巨大博客文章。 简而言之，它对高度抽象的音频流进行操作，并允许您以任意方式组合它们以创建新的流，并期望您插入单个输出流作为最终播放的音频。 有人甚至将其集成到自己的游戏引擎中:)

    您可以自己完成这一切，或者您可以找到一个为您进行音频混合的库。 我确信有数百个，但我没有进行彻底的搜索。

    资产

    资产是游戏的所有精灵、纹理、音频文件、3D 模型、关卡、AI 脚本等。同样，有很多方法可以处理它们。

    您可以将它们转换为编译到游戏可执行文件中的二进制数据。 优点是您不必考虑加载资源 - 它们就在这里，可以立即在代码中作为原始字节数组进行访问。 缺点是您无法在不重新编译游戏的情况下更改资源，这可能是一个问题（我通常保持良好的编译时间，这就是我使用这种方法很长一段时间的原因）。 另一个缺点是这种方法几乎不可能进行改装。

    您可以将资产简单地作为文件存储在游戏可执行文件旁边的某个资产文件夹中。 然后，代码中的资产管理器只需加载此文件，并且可能会进行一些缓存或预处理。 这种方法可能是最适合改装的方法，也是开发过程中最简单的方法。

    您可以将资源存储在存档中，无论是 ZIP 等广泛使用的格式，还是根据您的引擎需求量身定制的特殊格式（后者似乎是大多数大型引擎的选择方法）。

    在任何情况下，您可能希望使用一些特定于格式的库将原始资产字节转换为可用数据，例如stb_image 用于加载图像或 RapidJSON 用于加载一些 JSON 实体描述。

    您还可以支持热重载资源，尽管这很快就会变得更加复杂。

    物理

    现在，大多数游戏实际上不需要任何物理。 他们需要动画、逻辑和其他可能类似于物理的东西，但不是实际的物理。 例如，《文明 6》就没有物理学。 大多数城市建设游戏也没有。

    如果您正在制作类似平台游戏或自上而下的 2D RPG 之类的东西，那么您所有的物理特性都将归结为角色移动，也许还有一些非常基本的碰撞。 这些相对容易编写，更重要的是，与某些大型通用物理引擎相比，它们更容易根据您的特定需求进行调整。

    如果冲突太多，可以使用空间哈希或四叉树来优化它们。 如果您害怕四叉树，您不应该害怕：我写了一篇关于如何用几十行代码实现它们的博客文章。

    不管怎样，如果你绝对确定你需要真实的物理，请使用像 Box2D 或 Bullet 这样的库。 顺便说一下，Box2D 的创建者 Erin Catto 在网上有大量关于如何实现物理引擎（特别是基于脉冲的约束解析）的材料。

    脚本编写

    首先，什么是脚本？ 我们将其定义为对使用引擎编写语言以外的编程语言对游戏部分进行编程的支持。

    同样，并非所有游戏或游戏引擎都需要脚本。 毕竟，您已经在使用 C++ 等进行编程了，为什么要在游戏的某些部分使用全新的语言呢？ 以下是一些可能的原因：

    • 开发人员使用某些脚本语言通常比使用 C++ 等低级语言更具生产力（Sapiens 的创建者 David Frampton 在他的开发博客中表示，支持 Lua 脚本使他的生产力提高了几个数量级）
    • 如果代码是用脚本语言编写的，则在某些受保护的环境中运行代码会更容易
    • 与低级编译语言相比，解释型或 JIT 编译脚本语言更容易支持热重载代码（尽管这仍然很有可能）
    • 模组作者用脚本语言编写东西更容易

    Lua 是一种非常流行的脚本选择：它是一种非常简单但功能强大的语言。 Godot 引擎有自己的语言 GDScript。 您可以使用 Python 甚至 JavaScript 作为脚本语言。

    不过，请记住，并不是每个游戏都需要这个。

    联网

    像往常一样，一切都取决于您的特定需求。 也许您不打算制作多人游戏或任何使用网络的游戏。

    或者也许你会！ 在这种情况下，您的编程语言的标准库可能已经有一些异步套接字抽象；或者，如果您使用 C++，我推荐 Boost.Asio（如果您对 Boost 过敏，请使用独立的 Asio 版本）。

    不过，这仍然不完全是网络支持。 而且，说实话，我不知道这种支持是什么，因为除了我和朋友一起测试的几个愚蠢的原型之外，我从未编写过多人游戏。 也许看看你最喜欢的大型游戏引擎在网络方面的作用，或者看看一些开源的东西，比如 Valve 的 GameNetworkingSockets。

    AI

    你可能不会相信我，但并不是所有游戏都需要人工智能。 而那些通常确实只需要几个脚本的人。 事实上，一般来说人工智能只是代码，所以，如果你的引擎支持编写代码，它就有人工智能支持！ 耶！

    尽管您可能想要更多的东西，比如支持特定的人工智能编程模式，比如行为树，或目标驱动的人工智能，或其他东西。 顺便说一句，观看 Bobby Anguelov 谈论游戏 AI 方法。

    如果您有兴趣，我已经写了一篇关于我自己的行为树库设计的博客文章。 我认为库本身很好，但整个行为树方法有其缺点。

    UI

    我认为几乎每个游戏都需要 UI。 然而，UI 实际上只是一些对用户输入做出反应并在屏幕上绘制内容的对象，因此它们似乎与引擎的其余部分没有什么不同。 为什么要有专门的 UI 库？

    嗯，UI 的结构通常与典型的游戏实体不同，并且行为也不同。 它存在于窗口坐标系中，而不是所有游戏对象所在的世界坐标系中。 它有一些典型的预期行为，比如按钮应该对鼠标悬停或单击做出反应，滑块应该做出相应的行为，等等。尽管如此，以可重用的方式抽象所有这些是一项非常复杂的任务。 对您来说，在每个项目中从头开始重新实现 UI 可能比在引擎中添加 UI 支持更简单。

    您可能不会相信，但我已经写了一篇关于我自己的 UI 库的博客文章。 不过，这主要是对情况有多糟糕的咆哮。我目前正在设计一款新产品，希望能在 2024 年投入使用。

    建筑学

    好的，我们已经讨论了很多孤立的库，但现在我们需要将它们连接在一起。 或者，我们呢？

    我自己的引擎除了一组库之外没有任何特定的体系结构。 您创建一个项目，获取所需的库，然后它们就完成它们所做的事情。 它们被设计为尽可能隔离和独立（当然，在合理范围内）。 这很好而且很容易使用。

    然而，许多引擎强加了更加单一的架构，比如拥有一个所有游戏系统都应该子类化的基本对象类、一些全局对象管理器等等。 这对于提供详细自省和修改工具的大型引擎来说非常有用，但我怀疑它对于小型引擎是否有用。

    Tools

    说到工具，您猜对了，并不是每个引擎都需要它们。 我在引擎中使用的唯一工具是一个 python 脚本，它解析 Blender 文件并生成具有某种特殊格式的 3D 网格的二进制文件。 我不再使用它，因为我已经切换到 glTF 模型，并且我对这个决定感到非常满意。

    不过，大多数大型工业引擎都提供特殊工具，通常是一个大型编辑器，感觉就像 IDE + Blender，并允许您非常快速地预览工作结果。 然而，设计和实现这样的编辑器可能和制作游戏引擎本身一样困难；我绝对不建议为您的小型内部游戏引擎执行此操作。

    然而，制造更小、更专业的工具绝对是一个好主意。 也许出于性能原因您有一个特殊的关卡格式，并且您想要制作一个工具将 Blender 文件转换为您的格式并允许预览它们并立即查看更改。 也许您需要一些有趣的纹理转换器。 也许您需要时不时地验证一些资产。 投入时间在工具上绝对是个好主意，只是不要尝试制作另一个Unity。

    分配

    您已经制作了一个游戏引擎，在其中制作了一个简单的游戏，并将其发送给您的朋友来尝试。 你说他们无法启动它是什么意思？ 您确实发送了可执行文件而不是源代码，是吗？

    我们生活在一个悲伤的世界，程序无法在随机计算机上启动。 他们需要很多其他东西来运行。 如果您使用的语言可以编译为本机代码（操作系统无需任何额外帮助即可启动的文件），您仍然需要提供所需的动态库。 就我而言，这些是 SDL2.dll、libpng.dll 等。

    如果您使用的是编译为字节码的语言（例如 Java），那么您需要运行该字节码的东西，例如 JVM。 用户的机器上可能已经安装了某个版本的 JVM；但是，您不能保证这一点。 如果您使用解释性语言（例如 Python），则必须使用 Python 解释器来发布游戏。 你明白了。

    顺便说一句，即使是本机二进制文件实际上也需要特殊的启动器才能工作。 在 Linux 中，它的名称类似于 /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2，它会执行一些初始化并加载所需的动态库。

    支持多个平台会增加更多的痛苦，因为不同的平台有不同的可执行文件格式、动态库格式等。您必须编译游戏的多个不同版本，每个平台一个版本。 顺便说一句，请查看我的另一篇文章，了解如何将 C++ 引擎移植到 Android。

    自动化这一切可能是游戏引擎可以做的最重要的事情。 我使用特殊的 Ubuntu docker 容器来生成 Windows 和 Linux 版本（以及 mingw64 编译器来交叉编译到 Windows）以及一些 Bash 脚本和 CMake 魔法来完成所有这些工作。 准备这些是很痛苦的，但最终我可以通过一个命令一致地打包我的项目的可重复构建。

    第 3 部分：我该如何开始？

    我们已经讨论了游戏引擎可能具有或不具有的许多随机内容，在这一点上，编写游戏引擎的想法确实看起来相当令人生畏。 但请记住我们在文章开头讨论的内容：并非每个游戏或游戏引擎都需要一切。 一个创建窗口、提供最小 2D 图形的小型库以及一些创建游戏的可分发 ZIP 存档的构建脚本已经是一个非常不错的引擎了！

    那么，如何开始制造发动机呢？ 我的建议是不要专注于制作引擎，而是专注于制作游戏。

    参加游戏即兴活动，从头开始制作游戏，无需引擎。 庆祝你的成就。 休息一下。

    参加另一场游戏嘉年华，从头开始制作一款新游戏，而无需重复使用您为上一款游戏制作的任何内容。 经过几次这样的迭代之后，您会发现自己在想：天哪，如果不再一次又一次地编写这堆代码就好了，我希望我已经把它放在某个地方了！ 这就是您的发动机的诞生。

    仔细看看你的代码。 想想哪些部分可以被隔离和分开以便以后重复使用。 考虑一下您到底想如何使用这些部件。 将它们提取到一个新项目中——现在这就是您的引擎。 每当您发现自己一次又一次地编写相同的代码时，请将其放入引擎中，可能会负责概括此代码以使其更具可重用性，例如删除硬编码设置或不必要的依赖项以及修复错误和极端情况。

    一遍又一遍地重复此操作，一段时间后，您将拥有一个适合您的特定需求的良好引擎，一个您熟悉的引擎，一个您可以高效使用的引擎，一个您可以随时增强的引擎。

    正如我之前所说，这需要时间，它迫使你学习很多东西，但结果是值得的。

    或者，也许不是。 毕竟，这取决于你:)
